title: Airport transfers and staff wallet handoff notebook
content:
Purpose:
Quick personal scratchpad for APAC roadshow travel ops: airport pickup vendors, staff petty wallet protocol, receipts workflow, reimbursement naming conventions, and sticky items to resolve before departure. This is intentionally concise — meant for on-the-ground ops and handoff to next on-call.

Quick rules (TL;DR):
- All out-of-pocket expenses require a photo of receipt + short note in #receipts (Slack) within 24h.
- Staff wallet (float) issued only to designated event leads; returned with counted cash + receipts at end of day.
- Use expense code prefix TRV-APAC-26-<citycode> when submitting to Concur.

Airport transfer preferred vendors (notes + ETA/phone):
1) Tokyo (HND/NRT) - KAIHO Limousine Co. — contact: +81-3-5555-1020 (English ok). Typical 60–90 min to central hotels, confirm seat count for 6+ people for minivan. Book Day-of with 3hr lead.
2) Singapore (SIN) - GreenCab Corporate (Grab backup). contact: +65-6382-3344 (WhatsApp available). Use Grab corporate promo REDWOOD20 where accepted.
3) Seoul (ICN) - SeoulShuttle Ops — contact: +82-2-777-4441 (email ops@seoulshuttle.kr). Ask for toll-inclusive quote.
4) Jakarta (CGK) - BlueLine Tran: +62-21-522-1001 (driver English limited; assign bilingual escort).
Notes: always request a paper invoice or clear printed receipt for any cash tip. Driver contact + license plate saved to the event folder.

Staff wallet protocol (float):
- Float amount logic: base float = 250 USD equivalent per 6-person crew per day (adjust by local cost).
- Hand-off: event lead signs wallet handover form (photo of signed note accepted in #events-ops).
- Spending limits: max single spend without prior approvals = 75 USD equivalent. Anything above needs manager ok (Maya or Diego).
- Return: wallet counted, receipts stapled in chronological order, scanned and uploaded to Drive -> shared_drives/company/misc/roadshow-receipts/ (file naming convention below).

Receipts capture & reimbursement steps (one-liners):
1) Photograph receipt legibly right after transaction; upload to Slack #receipts with: date, merchant, amount (local + USD), card/cash, short purpose.
2) Rename file: TRV-APAC-26-<CITYCODE>_<YYYYMMDD>_<merchant-short>_<amount-local> (example: TRV-APAC-26-SIN_20260312_HotelRegalia_225SGD).
3) Concur claim: attach Slack thread link + Drive folder path + currency conversion note. Use XE.com rate at close of day.

Exchange rates & per-diem guidance:
- Use XE closing rate on the date of the expense. Use USD equivalents for reimbursements in Concur.
- Per-diem recommendation (local guidance): Tokyo 60 USD/day, Singapore 70 USD/day, Seoul 55 USD/day, Jakarta 35 USD/day. Team leads can approve deviations up to +20%.

Packing & quick checklist for on-call lead:
- Extra cash (local currency) sealed envelope for taxis and tips; label with city and handed to lead.
- Portable receipt scanner app (Adobe Scan / Microsoft Lens) pre-installed on event phones.
- Printed backup of hotel + flight itineraries for every crew member.
- Emergency vendor list (digital + one printed copy).

File naming conventions (enforced for easy audit):
- Wallet handover scans: WALLET_<CITYCODE>_<YYYYMMDD>_<lead-lastname> (e.g., WALLET_SIN_20260312_Patel)
- Receipt bundles (zipped if >10): TRV-APAC-26-<CITYCODE>_RECEIPTS_<YYYYMMDD>

Unresolved / sticky items (action owners):
- Confirm GreenCab corporate voucher code applicability with Singapore office (Diego) — status: pending follow-up by 2026-03-12.
- Verify if Concur will accept WhatsApp thread links as proof of submission (Maya) — status: in progress.
- Need a printed liability waiver template for on-site couriers (Samir) — draft attached to Confluence page.

On-the-ground escalation matrix (short):
- Event lead -> Events Ops (Maya) -> Legal (for vendor contracts) -> Finance (for urgent float replenishment).
- Emergency reimbursements: finance on-call (phone in Confluence contact card).

Notes to self / quick ideas:
- Consider a small prepaid travel card for floats in markets with weak cash acceptance — reduces cash-counting overhead.
- Try a QR-based receipt uploader form (Google Form) to capture structured metadata automatically.

Last-minute checklist (D-1):
- Confirm driver names + license plates for all arrivals.
- Print 2 copies of wallet handoff sheet; scan final copy to Drive.
- Confirm Grab promo code works on corporate account (Singapore).

If someone else is picking this up: read the Linked Artifacts above, ping @events-ops in Slack with the file link, and start by validating the vendor contact numbers an hour before first arrival window.

-- end of scratchpad --

(Version note: this is a working ops scratchpad — meant to be iterated after each roadshow leg.)
